system.description:
With your Weapon in hand, you strike with a flurry of focus and grace befitting of the weapons chosen striking preference. Make 2 melee taijutsu attacks, dealing your [Weapons Damage] or [Unarmed Damage]. If at least one attack scores a hit, the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, based on the damage type of your weapon this jutsu inflicts a different condition.

Bludgeoning. Bruised.

Piercing. +1 rank of Weakened.

Slashing. +1 rank of Bleeding.

Battle Lust: By spending 2 Battle Lust when this jutsu is cast, you can force the affected creature to make the saving throw twice, inflicting any of the listed conditions on a failure regardless of the damage type used.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage you deal by 1d6.
